 SALT LAKE CITY (KUTV) — Two products recalled by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission on November 5 pose risks to children and infants.
 Arlopu is recalling about 10,318 slide playsets because openings can trap a child’s head or neck. On model KT-CS17, the basketball net can also come unhooked and form a loop large enough to create an entanglement or strangulation hazard. The playsets were sold on Amazon and Walmart.com from April 2023 through August 2026 for $90 to $130. Model KT-CS17 is printed under the elevated platform; model LY-31 is on the upper back panel behind the slide.
 Consumers should stop using the playsets and store them away from children. Contact Arlopu at arlopu_support@163.com or 800-657-9218 for a free repair kit with redesigned panels, basketball hoops and instructions. The company reported one entrapment incident that caused abrasions on a child’s neck.

 Kikea Store is recalling about 19,596 X-VESOLJE nursing pillows because they can block an infant’s breathing and pose a suffocation hazard. The C-shaped pillows, model NP001, were sold on Amazon from April 2025 through June 2026 for $24 to $34. They come in white with a leaves pattern, dark brown with multicolored feathers, and a multicolored puzzle-piece pattern.
 Consumers should stop using the pillows and contact Kikea Store at zsally929@gmail.com for a full refund. After confirming the pillow with the company, customers will be asked to cut it in half, email a photo of the destroyed pillow and then dispose of it. No injuries have been reported.
